title: ASIC Design Verification Technical Leader
teaser: Become part of our team as an ASIC Design Verification Technical Leader, responsible for test planning and development of test benches. Collaborate with design and verification teams to ensure integration and validation of test logic. Ideal for candidates with significant experience in test planning and system Verilog.
description:
This is a hybrid role with four days per week at Cisco’s Yerevan office.

Meet the team

Join a dynamic group dedicated to ensuring robust test infrastructure for cutting-edge hardware solutions. Our team collaborates closely with design and product development teams, playing a pivotal role in the integration and validation of test logic throughout the development lifecycle. With a diverse mix of experienced engineers, the team thrives on innovation, problem-solving, and mutual support. The fast-paced, collaborative environment provides opportunities to learn and grow while working on industry-leading technologies. What’s exciting is the chance to influence product quality and reliability at a foundational level.

Your impact

Drive comprehensive test planning and develop advanced test benches to ensure design integrity. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate and validate test logic at every phase of implementation. Utilize scripting and debugging tools to streamline verification workflows and identify issues efficiently. Apply your expertise to optimize test processes and enhance product quality. Deliver critical verification solutions that directly impact the success and reliability of our products.

Minimum qualifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering or any related field.

7+ years of experience in design verification.

Prior experience in test planning based on complex design specifications.

Proficiency in testbench development using System Verilog.

Debugging experience preferably using DVE and Verdi.

Strong scripting skills with at least one of Tcl, Python and Perl.

Knowledge of constrained-random verification and functional coverage.

Knowledge of ASIC design flow and verification methodologies.

Preferred qualifications

UVM and advanced System Verilog knowledge.

Knowledge of JTAG protocol.

Familiarity with SLM IP and verification strategies.

Ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Good communication skills and ability to work in a team environment.

These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
